# Ozturksoft

> Ozturksoft (Öztürksoft Yazılım) is a software development and applied AI company based in Çankaya, Ankara, Turkey. It builds custom software, web and mobile applications, LLM / ChatGPT integrations, chatbots, AI agents, document OCR, ERP and marketplace integrations, and provides SEO and GEO services. It works with companies and public-sector organizations across Turkey and remotely with clients in the EU, MENA and CIS. Every project starts with a free discovery call and a written, fixed-scope proposal.

Prices below are 2026 ranges in Turkish lira (TL) published on the linked pages; the final price is set in the written proposal after discovery. Service pages use Turkish URLs and switch language on the page (TR, EN, DE, FR, AR, RU).

## Company facts

- Brand / legal name: Ozturksoft (Öztürksoft Yazılım)

- Phone: +90 546 549 6806
- Email: info@ozturksoft.net
- Contact and quote form: https://ozturksoft.net/iletisim
- Working hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00 (Turkey time); online support at weekends 10:00–16:00
- Languages: Turkish, English, German, French, Arabic, Russian
- Service area: all of Turkey on-site or remote; international clients remote
- Independent profiles: [Clutch](https://clutch.co/profile/ozturksoft), [GoodFirms](https://www.goodfirms.co/company/ozturksoft)
- Practices: written scope, source-code handover, QA and automated tests, KVKK (Turkish data protection law) compliance, on-premise AI option, 30–90 days post-launch support

## AI services

- [Yapay zeka entegrasyonu / AI integration](https://ozturksoft.net/yapay-zeka-entegrasyonu): ChatGPT / GPT integration 40,000–80,000 TL; RAG over company documents 80,000–200,000 TL; on-premise LLM 150,000–500,000+ TL
- [Chatbot development](https://ozturksoft.net/chatbot-yaptirmak): FAQ bot 25,000–45,000 TL; GPT web chatbot 45,000–80,000 TL; RAG chatbot 80,000–150,000 TL
- [WhatsApp chatbot](https://ozturksoft.net/whatsapp-chatbot-yaptirmak): FAQ 40,000–70,000 TL; GPT 60,000–100,000 TL; CRM-connected 90,000–160,000 TL (WhatsApp Business API)
- [Private company ChatGPT / on-premise AI](https://ozturksoft.net/kurum-ici-yapay-zeka): assistant on the client's own server, answering from company documents with citations (open-source LLM + RAG); pilot 40,000–80,000 TL; RAG assistant 80,000–200,000 TL; full on-premise 150,000–500,000+ TL plus hardware
- [AI agent development](https://ozturksoft.net/ai-agent): proof of concept 60,000–120,000 TL; enterprise 150,000–280,000 TL; on-premise 280,000–500,000+ TL
- [AI consulting](https://ozturksoft.net/yapay-zeka-danismanligi): roadmap 25,000–60,000 TL; PoC 40,000–80,000 TL
- [Invoice and document OCR](https://ozturksoft.net/fatura-okuma): single document type 45,000–90,000 TL; multiple types 90,000–180,000 TL
- [OCR and document reading software](https://ozturksoft.net/ocr-belge-okuma): custom-built OCR + AI for contracts, forms, bank documents, public-sector correspondence and scanned archives; single document type 45,000–90,000 TL; multiple types 90,000–180,000 TL; on-premise and large archives quoted after discovery
- [Process automation (RPA + AI)](https://ozturksoft.net/surec-otomasyonu): single process 40,000–80,000 TL; department 80,000–180,000 TL; ERP-integrated 120,000–250,000 TL
- [AI tender document analysis](https://ozturksoft.net/ihale-sartname-analizi-yapay-zeka) (Turkish): eligibility checklists, deadlines, risk clauses and technical compliance tables from tender specifications; pilot 40,000–80,000 TL; on-premise option
- [Public-sector AI](https://ozturksoft.net/ankara-kamu-yapay-zeka): on-premise LLM, document OCR, e-government workflows
- [AI assistant product](https://ozturksoft.net/ankara-ai-asistan): WhatsApp, web and CRM assistant with on-premise option

## Integrations

- [Logo Tiger / Netsis](https://ozturksoft.net/logo-netsis-entegrasyon) and [Mikro](https://ozturksoft.net/mikro-entegrasyon): one-way API 20,000–45,000 TL; two-way sync 55,000–130,000 TL
- [E-invoice (e-Fatura, e-Arşiv, e-İrsaliye)](https://ozturksoft.net/e-fatura-entegrasyonu): connector 35,000–70,000 TL; e-archive + e-dispatch 70,000–140,000 TL
- Marketplaces — [Trendyol](https://ozturksoft.net/trendyol-entegrasyonu), [Hepsiburada / N11 / ikas](https://ozturksoft.net/hepsiburada-entegrasyonu), [Amazon SP-API](https://ozturksoft.net/amazon-entegrasyonu): orders 25,000–50,000 TL; stock + shipping 50,000–95,000 TL; marketplace + ERP 95,000–180,000 TL

## Search visibility

- [Ankara SEO](https://ozturksoft.net/ankara-seo): technical SEO 25,000–45,000 TL; local SEO 45,000–80,000 TL; SEO + GEO 80,000–140,000 TL. Paid ads and social media management are not offered.
- [GEO optimization](https://ozturksoft.net/geo-optimizasyonu): visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. GEO audit 15,000–25,000 TL; GEO setup 35,000–60,000 TL. No ranking guarantees.
- [Google spam update penalty recovery](https://ozturksoft.net/google-spam-update-cezasi-kurtarma): diagnosis of traffic drops after Google spam updates or manual actions, cleanup (scaled content, unnatural links, hacked pages, cloaking), disavow and reconsideration requests. Diagnosis 15,000–25,000 TL; cleanup and recovery 40,000–90,000 TL; recovery + SEO + GEO 80,000–150,000 TL. No recovery guarantees.
